meter_watch_note: Continuous polls such as {tool} are free, which is why the two numbers differ.
error_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
error_repo_unresolved: That repository could not be resolved. Check the slug or remote against what is registered.
error_repo_slug_taken: That repository name is already in use.
error_remote_taken: That remote is already registered to another repository.
error_wrong_status: The job is not in a state that allows this.
error_already_claimed: Another agent has already claimed that job.
error_ticket_already_linked: That ticket is already linked to an open job.
error_dependency_cycle: That would make the jobs depend on each other in a circle.
error_lease_held: Another agent holds the lease on that repository. It will expire.
error_lease_not_held: You do not hold the lease on that repository.
error_team_slug_taken: That team name is already in use.
error_team_in_use: That team still has repositories assigned to it.
error_not_a_member: That account is not a member of this organization.
error_already_a_member: That account is already a member.
error_invite_invalid: That invitation is not valid. It may have been used already, or expired.
error_invite_wrong_account: That invitation was issued to a different address. Sign in as the invited account.
error_internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again shortly.
error_forbidden: Your role does not allow that.
error_invalid_credentials: That did not work. Try again.
error_ceremony_expired: That took too long. Start again.
error_credential_already_registered: That authenticator is already registered to this account.
error_unknown_credential: That passkey is not registered here. Try a different one.
error_last_passkey: This is the only passkey on the account. Add another before removing this one.
error_last_owner: An organization has to keep at least one owner.
error_credential_expired: That code has expired or has already been used.
error_wrong_audience: That token was issued for a different service.
error_sso_required: This organization requires signing in through its identity provider.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error_invalid_client: That application is not registered here.
error_invalid_grant: That authorization is no longer valid. Start the connection again.
error_unsupported_grant_type: This server does not support that way of getting a token.
error_invalid_scope: That set of permissions is not one this server issues.
error_tracker_unreachable: The issue tracker could not be reached. Try again shortly.
error_passkey_cancelled: No passkey was used. Try again when you are ready.
error_passkey_already_registered: That authenticator is already registered to this account.
error_passkey_misconfigured: This site is not configured correctly for passkeys. Tell whoever runs it that the relying party ID does not match this origin.
error_session_resolve_failed: Something went wrong resolving your session.
